Uniplus Educational Consultancy has a team of highly qualified and experienced professionals who are knowledgeable about the education system and have a thorough understanding of the admission process.
Network Of Universities
Uniplus Educational Consultancy has a wide network of universities across the world and can help students find the best fit for their educational goals. best education consultancy in Hyderabad.

Our Services
Career Counseling
Our experienced counselors provide personalized guidance to help students choose the right career path that suits their skills, interests, and aspirations.
Student Visa
Our team of experts will assist students in the visa application process and provide guidance on the necessary documentation required for the student visa.
University Selection
We help students choose the right university by providing information on courses, fees, admission requirements, and the campus life.
Admission Guidance
Our admission specialists guide students through the admission process and help them secure a place in their preferred university.
Visa Documentation
Our team of experts will ensure that all the necessary documents are in order for a smooth visa application process.
Accommodation/sim card
We help students find suitable accommodation and provide assistance with obtaining a sim card for their mobile phone.
Travel Assistance
We provide guidance on travel arrangements and assist with booking flights and transportation to and from the university.
Pre Departure Guidance
Our team provides information on the customs and culture of the destination country, as well as tips on how to settle in and adjust to the new environment.
Forex Service
Our services include aiding in currency exchange and financial management for individuals traveling or studying overseas.
Immigration
Our experts provide guidance on immigration policies and procedures and assist with any immigration-related concerns.
Test Preparation
We offer test preparation classes to help students succeed in entrance exams such as IELTS, TOEFL, and GRE.
